transferable_mechanism.reader_job: Compare alternatives across the same decision criteria without asking the reader to reconcile separate cards.
transferable_mechanism.mechanism: Use one stable row definition, one shared denominator, and visible emphasis only where a comparison is legitimate.
transferable_mechanism.use_condition: Only when all columns use comparable definitions, units, time windows, and sources.

anti_copy_boundary: Do not reuse the source post-type categories, layout, performance claims, hand tag, exact column colours, metrics, or winner treatment.

claim_boundary.note: Rates and comparative outcomes are visibly asserted in the asset. They are not a transferable benchmark or publishable Shetty’s Desk evidence.
